description: This header defines utility functions related to user and group information, such as retrieving group IDs from names, checking group membership, and obtaining user home directories within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: GroupIdFromName
methods.description: Returns the group ID for a given group name.

methods.name: InGroup
methods.description: Checks if the current user belongs to a specified group.

methods.name: SystemWideUserHome
methods.description: Returns the user's home directory as defined by the system.
